deck.title: Global Patterns of Food Supply & Demand

front_blocks.md: Roughly how many calories does a person need each day to live a healthy, active life?

back_blocks.md: About **2,500 calories** per day.

cards.front_md: Roughly how many calories does a person need each day to live a healthy, active life?
cards.back_md: About **2,500 calories** per day.

front_blocks.md: Is there enough food produced to feed the world's population? Explain the problem.

back_blocks.md: **Yes** — sufficient food is produced, but the **distribution is unequal**, so some areas consume more than needed and others fewer.

cards.front_md: Is there enough food produced to feed the world's population? Explain the problem.
cards.back_md: **Yes** — sufficient food is produced, but the **distribution is unequal**, so some areas consume more than needed and others fewer.

front_blocks.md: Name two regions where people typically consume **more** calories than needed, and two where they consume **fewer**.

back_blocks.md: **More**: the **USA** and **Europe**. **Fewer**: **Pakistan**, **Venezuela** and **sub-Saharan Africa** (any two).

cards.front_md: Name two regions where people typically consume **more** calories than needed, and two where they consume **fewer**.
cards.back_md: **More**: the **USA** and **Europe**. **Fewer**: **Pakistan**, **Venezuela** and **sub-Saharan Africa** (any two).

front_blocks.md: Global food consumption is rising partly because the world **______** has now reached 8 billion.

back_blocks.md: Global food consumption is rising partly because the world **population** has now reached 8 billion.

cards.front_md: Global food consumption is rising partly because the world **______** has now reached 8 billion.
cards.back_md: Global food consumption is rising partly because the world **population** has now reached 8 billion.

front_blocks.md: Besides population growth, give two reasons global food consumption is increasing.

back_blocks.md: As countries **develop**, people have money to buy more food; and **transport** of food is easier and cheaper than in the past.

cards.front_md: Besides population growth, give two reasons global food consumption is increasing.
cards.back_md: As countries **develop**, people have money to buy more food; and **transport** of food is easier and cheaper than in the past.

front_blocks.md: Why do people in HICs tend to have a higher calorie consumption than those in LICs?

back_blocks.md: HIC diets are **richer in fats and sugars**, while LIC diets tend to focus on **lower fat and higher fibre**.

cards.front_md: Why do people in HICs tend to have a higher calorie consumption than those in LICs?
cards.back_md: HIC diets are **richer in fats and sugars**, while LIC diets tend to focus on **lower fat and higher fibre**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Government investment in agriculture tends to be higher in LICs than in HICs.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Investment in agriculture tends to be **higher in HICs**, where subsidies often help support farmers.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

Government investment in agriculture tends to be higher in LICs than in HICs.
cards.back_md:
**False.**

Investment in agriculture tends to be **higher in HICs**, where subsidies often help support farmers.

front_blocks.md: How does **climate** affect food production?

back_blocks.md: Crops and animals require suitable conditions; climate determines whether there is **enough, too little or too much precipitation and sunshine**.

cards.front_md: How does **climate** affect food production?
cards.back_md: Crops and animals require suitable conditions; climate determines whether there is **enough, too little or too much precipitation and sunshine**.

front_blocks.md: Which four properties of **soil** influence the types of crops that can be grown?

back_blocks.md: Soil **depth**, **structure**, **fertility** and **pH**.

cards.front_md: Which four properties of **soil** influence the types of crops that can be grown?
cards.back_md: Soil **depth**, **structure**, **fertility** and **pH**.

front_blocks.md: The availability of **______** will impact on the yield produced by a farm.

back_blocks.md: The availability of **technology** will impact on the yield produced by a farm.

cards.front_md: The availability of **______** will impact on the yield produced by a farm.
cards.back_md: The availability of **technology** will impact on the yield produced by a farm.

front_blocks.md: How does **crop choice** affect how many people can be fed?

back_blocks.md: Some crops feed **more people** than others, so choosing suitable crops increases the number of people who can be fed.

cards.front_md: How does **crop choice** affect how many people can be fed?
cards.back_md: Some crops feed **more people** than others, so choosing suitable crops increases the number of people who can be fed.

front_blocks.md: Give three reasons global food **production** has increased.

back_blocks.md: Greater **land availability** (e.g. from deforestation); increased **productivity** through mechanisation, GM crops, agrochemicals and irrigation; and increased **wealth**, **education** and **globalisation** (any three).

cards.front_md: Give three reasons global food **production** has increased.
cards.back_md: Greater **land availability** (e.g. from deforestation); increased **productivity** through mechanisation, GM crops, agrochemicals and irrigation; and increased **wealth**, **education** and **globalisation** (any three).

front_blocks.md: Name three sources of new farmland that have raised food production.

back_blocks.md: **Deforestation**, **wetland clearing** and **brownfield site conversion**.

cards.front_md: Name three sources of new farmland that have raised food production.
cards.back_md: **Deforestation**, **wetland clearing** and **brownfield site conversion**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Because global food production has increased, food consumption has risen equally everywhere.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Food consumption is **unequal** — it varies regionally and internationally, and **HICs consume more calories than LICs**.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

Because global food production has increased, food consumption has risen equally everywhere.
cards.back_md:
**False.**

Food consumption is **unequal** — it varies regionally and internationally, and **HICs consume more calories than LICs**.

front_blocks.md: China's meat consumption rose from 12kg per person in 1980 to over **______** per person by 2023, as incomes rose.

back_blocks.md: China's meat consumption rose from 12kg per person in 1980 to over **62kg** per person by 2023, as incomes rose.

cards.front_md: China's meat consumption rose from 12kg per person in 1980 to over **______** per person by 2023, as incomes rose.
cards.back_md: China's meat consumption rose from 12kg per person in 1980 to over **62kg** per person by 2023, as incomes rose.

front_blocks.md: Why does a growing middle class in developing countries increase food consumption?

back_blocks.md: People can afford **more food** or more **expensive, calorie-rich foods** such as meat.

cards.front_md: Why does a growing middle class in developing countries increase food consumption?
cards.back_md: People can afford **more food** or more **expensive, calorie-rich foods** such as meat.

front_blocks.md: How can hunger create a **vicious cycle** in LICs?

back_blocks.md: People too poor to afford food cannot work due to **hunger or ill health**, so they earn no money to buy food — keeping them trapped.

cards.front_md: How can hunger create a **vicious cycle** in LICs?
cards.back_md: People too poor to afford food cannot work due to **hunger or ill health**, so they earn no money to buy food — keeping them trapped.

front_blocks.md: Define **globalisation**.

back_blocks.md: **Globalisation** is where the world has become more **interconnected** through the processes of economics, culture, politics, trade and tourism.

cards.front_md: Define **globalisation**.
cards.back_md: **Globalisation** is where the world has become more **interconnected** through the processes of economics, culture, politics, trade and tourism.

front_blocks.md: Which two improvements have let food be moved around the world more quickly and efficiently?

back_blocks.md: Improvements in **refrigeration** and **air transport**.

cards.front_md: Which two improvements have let food be moved around the world more quickly and efficiently?
cards.back_md: Improvements in **refrigeration** and **air transport**.

front_blocks.md: Why has land availability in LICs and MICs contributed to the globalisation of food?

back_blocks.md: It has **attracted agribusinesses** to those areas.

cards.front_md: Why has land availability in LICs and MICs contributed to the globalisation of food?
cards.back_md: It has **attracted agribusinesses** to those areas.

front_blocks.md: How has rising global demand for **acai berries** affected their source country?

back_blocks.md: The price has increased **60 times**, so **Indigenous Amazonian communities** can no longer afford them in their diets, and irrigation demand pressures water supplies.

cards.front_md: How has rising global demand for **acai berries** affected their source country?
cards.back_md: The price has increased **60 times**, so **Indigenous Amazonian communities** can no longer afford them in their diets, and irrigation demand pressures water supplies.

front_blocks.md: The spread of Western fast food chains such as **______** and KFC can lead to the loss of traditional diets and higher obesity in some MICs and LICs.

back_blocks.md: The spread of Western fast food chains such as **McDonalds** and KFC can lead to the loss of traditional diets and higher obesity in some MICs and LICs.

cards.front_md: The spread of Western fast food chains such as **______** and KFC can lead to the loss of traditional diets and higher obesity in some MICs and LICs.
cards.back_md: The spread of Western fast food chains such as **McDonalds** and KFC can lead to the loss of traditional diets and higher obesity in some MICs and LICs.

front_blocks.md: State three environmental problems caused by increased monocultures and large-scale commercial farming.

back_blocks.md: Increased **soil erosion**, **habitat destruction and loss of biodiversity**, and increased use of **pesticides and fertilisers**.

cards.front_md: State three environmental problems caused by increased monocultures and large-scale commercial farming.
cards.back_md: Increased **soil erosion**, **habitat destruction and loss of biodiversity**, and increased use of **pesticides and fertilisers**.

front_blocks.md: How has globalisation changed the **seasonality** of food for consumers?

back_blocks.md: **Seasonal foods are now available all year round**.

cards.front_md: How has globalisation changed the **seasonality** of food for consumers?
cards.back_md: **Seasonal foods are now available all year round**.
